headline: Enciso earns Ipswich a point, but Forest pressure tells

sentences.text: Ipswich Town had to settle for a point at Portman Road, but Julio Enciso’s 41st-minute equaliser ensured a deserved share of the spoils after Nott'm Forest struck first.
Neco Williams put the visitors ahead in the 13th minute, and Ipswich showed resilience to reach half-time level.
The second half brought no further goals, leaving the teams with a 1–1 draw.
There is plenty to value in the point, though Forest had the clearer attacking threat: they led 17–7 on shots and 2.29–0.46 on expected goals.
Ipswich had 49% possession and goalkeeper saves were 3–2 in their favour, but Forest also had 5 corners to Ipswich’s 0.
The result moves Ipswich up to 9th with 10 points from 8 matches, a useful reward for an afternoon that demanded a strong response after conceding.
